blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Tourism acts as the backbone of Goa's economy, driving local employment and service sector growth.
Goa offers diverse forms of tourism, including beach, heritage, cultural, and eco-tourism.
Mining, primarily focused on iron ore and manganese, historically forms a significant export sector.
Mormugao Port is a major natural harbor vital for bulk mineral ore exports in India.
Agriculture remains essential, with rice (paddy), cashew, and coconut being prominent crops.

blocks.content: Goa has the highest per capita income among all Indian states and one of the highest Human Development Index (HDI) scores. The economy is primarily driven by tourism, mining, and services. Agriculture and fisheries also play important roles.

cells: Mormugao Port (Major Port — one of 13 major ports of India)
Major source of livelihood; Goa is 'Land of Fish and Coconut'

blocks.content: 4.2 Tourism — The Backbone of Goa's Economy
Tourism — The Backbone of Goa's Economy

Tourism is Goa's most important industry, accounting for 16–35% of the state's GSDP depending on the season. Goa received over 8 million domestic and 0.7 million international tourists annually before COVID-19.

items: Beach Tourism — Calangute, Baga, Palolem, Anjuna, Colva
Heritage Tourism — Old Goa Churches, Goa Museum, Ancestral Goa (Loutolim)
Wildlife Tourism — Bhagwan Mahavir NP, Bondla, Cotigao, Netravali
Medical Tourism — Goa's hospitals attract medical tourists from Africa and neighboring countries
Adventure Tourism — Water sports, trekking, kayaking
MICE Tourism (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions)
Sustainable / Eco-tourism — Growing segment in eastern Goa

rows: Primary revenue generator; encompasses eco-tourism, beach, and heritage tourism.
Focuses on iron ore and manganese extraction for global export markets.
A premier major port handling bulk mineral exports from Goa's mining belt.
Sustains rural livelihoods through paddy cultivation, cashew, and coconut plantations.

blocks.content: Goa was once among the top exporters of iron ore in the world. The mining sector went through a major crisis following the Shah Commission (2012) and subsequent Supreme Court orders.

items: Iron ore mining: Primarily in Bicholim, Sattari, Sanguem, and Quepem talukas
Goa had 90+ mining leases; the Supreme Court cancelled all of them in 2018
The Goa Foundation vs Union of India case (2014) was a landmark Supreme Court judgment
Mining was partially resumed after legislative changes in 2020–2022
Vedanta Group (Sesa Goa), NMDC, and various private firms operate mines in Goa

blocks.content: Mormugao Port Trust (MPT) is one of the 13 major ports of India, managed by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways. It handles the bulk of Goa's external trade.

items: Mormugao Port is frequently tested as one of India's principal major natural harbors driving iron ore exports.
Cashew and paddy (rice) are high-yield questions regarding Goa's chief agricultural products.
Environmental regulations and legal aspects surrounding iron ore mining in Goa are major points of interest for competitive exams.
Located at the mouth of the Zuari River in Mormugao, South Goa
Primarily handles iron ore, coal, fertilizers, petroleum products
Also serves as a cruise terminal
Mormugao Port handled over 20 million tonnes of cargo annually before mining ban
